title: She became the first woman CEO in U.S. Bancorp's 160-year history.
sources: U.S. Bancorp Investor Relations - Gunjan Kedia named CEO, effective April 15, 2025 annual meeting
CNBC - U.S. Bancorp names Gunjan Kedia as first female CEO
Banking Dive - U.S. Bancorp's CEO transition coverage
caption:
She became the first woman CEO in U.S. Bancorp's 160-year history.

Kedia had already spent years rising through U.S. Bancorp's leadership, most recently as President - the bank's second-highest role - before the board named her Chief Executive Officer, effective at the close of the April 2025 annual shareholder meeting.

U.S. Bancorp, one of the largest regional banks in the United States, had never had a female CEO since its founding. Kedia also joined the company's Board of Directors alongside taking the role.

From tech to banking, Indian-origin executives now run some of the largest companies in the world. Each one that breaks a barrier that specific company held for over a century makes the next one less remarkable and more expected.
